title: Pause / Resume / Abort command, Mobile to Unity (protocol 1)
description: Argument of UnitySendMessage("Fire3DBridge", "Pause" | "Resume" | "Abort", argument). Pause when the app goes to the background (Unity also pauses itself and flushes its events); Resume when the Unity activity is in the foreground again; Abort stops the play, and the session is then completed with endReason Abandoned (Assessment outcome Incomplete). Unity ignores the argument: Mobile sends an empty string for Pause and Resume and {"reason": ...} for Abort.

sessionId.description: Optional; when present it must be the running session.

reason.description: Optional, for logs only, e.g. BackButton, LaunchGrantExpired.
